role: Separate Astra test-author acceptance/test-seam assistance; not formal code reviewer or independent completion auditor
summary: Twelve parameterized evidence groups cover gameplay/runtime acceptances, with E01/E02 owning regression and procedural completion. These are minimum distinct oracle families, not a claim that twelve individual test functions suffice. Reuse existing helpers and preserve existing authorship/history.

Current product provides numeric relic plans, finite Flow, aura/shared shield and runtime facts. New closure, typed property support, effect-only recipe and fixed single-target semantics require new published observability and executor work. No currently unimplemented U09 behavior is labeled an existing product defect.
source_identity_limit: Per-file hashes below bind this static review. U08 completed source438 hash is historical basis, not a new U09 product freeze or a claim that every current product file was rehashed.

important_findings.claim: Current prospective plan exposes numeric damage targets only. Public support descriptors, closure/reason rows, generated identity/contributors and effect-specific post-recipe properties must be observable to prove policies01-07/13. Do not parse compiler internals as sole public evidence.

Existing area aura computes membership from all live eligible employee units and admits new deployment identities. Single-support policy08 instead pins a selected battle identity, handles temporary range exit/reentry and permanently ends invalid identity connection. Existing area tests remain baseline and cannot prove new single semantics.

Monk predicate is settled bite HpLost>0. Flow condition already reads actual_hp_loss after producer phase2. ResolvedTargets/contact/shield absorption/kill count and proportional self-lifesteal are distinct predicates; no test of those alone satisfies once fixed Self heal.
Several tests named public use private scenario, roster, manual-skill or forced-node setup. Preserve them for component behavior; use external pack/trial plus normal grant/equip journey to satisfy13.

FactSummary stores fixed cardinality latest witnesses, not all historical hits. ActionSnapshot has aggregate FactSummary; actor caused/received summaries and target HP deltas are available. A global latest_damage or AmountQuery::Latest cannot prove all multi-target or same-bucket hits. Use isolated commands/known targets, per-actor deltas and action aggregate; bounded trace only when each event must be retained.

Sustained snapshot exposes activation/caster/target/members/expiry/shield capacity+remaining and fragment copy, enabling membership/pool checks. It does not by itself expose every U09 contributor/closure/selected-target contract; root must decide exact DTO extension and source relationships.

Do not invent employee active Auto, official shield S/duration/4S corruption, permanent channel or official corruption penalties. Respect agreed fetus final states; other constants in this report are representative fixture oracles.

COVERAGE_013 counts.main_conditions207 =191 conditions+16 groups. U09 predecessor acceptance union is191+32 sentences=223 unique IDs, plus separate31 R06 acceptance rows. Use the actual ID arrays below, not the207 aggregate.

Current damage_source_snapshot_template_for_unit applies aura bonus to all DamageSource::BasicAttack. basic_attack computes AttackKind Auto/Triggered from schedule_next but builds a BasicAttack source snapshot for both. ExtraAttack emits ScheduleAttack; commands schedules it with schedule_next=false. U09 regular-only rule therefore needs an explicit occurrence distinction in the consumer and a generated ExtraAttack/Triggered exclusion oracle. This is required new implementation behavior, not an existing R11 regression verdict or acceptance relaxation.
important_findings.origin: Root relayed Sol finding; this reviewer independently read the cited source ranges.

public_observation_requirements: Prospective query is read-only: repeated request preserves public roots/IDs and exposes source provenance without action authority. Existing unresolved RuntimeContextRequired behavior remains explicit.
Runtime protection witness must include actual HP loss and ordered absorption owner; post-mitigation calculated damage alone cannot prove HP-loss branch.
Separate original provider, granting relic and modifying relic contribution identities. Provenance does not synthesize cast/reinput capabilities.
Public tests establish externally usable behavior; ownership/retained/clone assertions require complementary internal component seams. Do not label private owner fields public.

reuse_inventory.limit: content packages official plus independent new-ID RON and loads before application setup. admin supplies fixtures; grant_relic alone does not prove normal acquisition. event.rs makes normal reward selections but uses admin_enter_event, so keep that scope explicit; R04 supplies the full normal external journey.
Current targets are skill_damage/basic_attack_damage only. Does not expose finite closure, generated effect graph or typed non-damage property support.

R12 case runs actual public steps and checks amount trace and observation-mode equality. It does not independently prove single selected-target support or exact shield2S arithmetic. Amount Latest is one selected amount observation, not all targets.
Adapt fixture RON and expected values for new structural plans; preserve historical authored tests and receipt identity.

r11_employee_effect_core mutates scenario/employee/manual skill state internally. public in selector names is not proof of normal acquisition. Existing aura auto-joins eligible new deployment identities and is a baseline area behavior, not new fixed-target semantics.
Existing pool600, mitigated400 then350 yields remaining200 then HP loss150. Internal setup; no existing claim of single2S, recipient-modifier exclusion or fixed-target identity.

Helper mutates GameDataBuilder, roster charge/grants and forces combat node; normal commands after setup do not make the whole setup a public normal path. r11 query test currently only checks serialized sustained_effects presence; stronger numeric public assertions are needed.
Direct world helpers are component seams. New structural/generated owner retention needs fresh evidence; old numeric results cannot prove it.
Keep prior tests and expected legacy costs; add new closure/generated owner costs and failures rather than changing caps to fit.

HpLost expression test heals its target proportionally to HP loss; it is not one fixed self-heal after a multi-target bite. Existing R10 finite Flow validation is not the new relic dependency-cycle proof.

minimum_new_evidence_groups.title: Seeded finite closure and same-effect selectors
minimum_new_evidence_groups.setup: Author finite named effects: A requires tag b and grants tag a; B requires tag a and grants tag b. Test empty seed, authored seed a, authored seed b, unconditional grant seed, seed removal, and all six three-slot permutations. Split tag/property/identity conditions across effects as negative controls; put all on one effect as positive. Include form/equipment/fragment mismatch and post-recipe missing property.
independent_oracle: No seed: A/B dormant. Seed a: B then A active; seed b: A then B active. Removing the sole seed returns both dormant even after previous activation. Expected reachable set is enumerated in fixture, never computed by product closure.

Same-effect AND: two different effects collectively carrying requirements remain ineligible. Generated effect receives the identical selector rule. Compare canonical effect sets, final values and reason codes; provenance identity may differ when different UUIDs are deliberately used.
minimum_new_evidence_groups.required_observation: Public closure/explain rows for seed identity, generated effect identity, active/dormant reasons, property support; real execution for generated positive case in T10.
minimum_new_evidence_groups.limitations: Current numeric-plan DTO is insufficient for closure-state proof. Do not add arbitrary iteration cap or reject all positive cycles.

minimum_new_evidence_groups.title: Publication and candidate rejection table
minimum_new_evidence_groups.setup: External RON variants: NOT cycle; recursively fresh generated identity; unstable self-changing structural dependency; invalid Flow reference; unsupported reactive grant; unknown/private property; wrong property unit; invalid recipe target; conflicting write bundles. Retain a validated token and nonempty application state before each replacement.
independent_oracle: Each invalid case fails before replacement publication or candidate commit with a typed source/site/reason; original token identity, run/save bytes, copy/loadout and next valid deterministic operation remain unchanged.
Valid finite positive cycle with seed remains accepted. Identical semantic Replace coalesces rather than being rejected.
minimum_new_evidence_groups.required_observation: Loader/validation diagnostics and unchanged public roots; candidate equip/variant failure for cases only decidable per loadout.
minimum_new_evidence_groups.limitations: Do not assert current reject-unknown-field error as final typed U09 diagnostic. Formal diagnostic names belong to product contract.

minimum_new_evidence_groups.title: Typed Add Scale Replace arithmetic and conflict permutations
minimum_new_evidence_groups.setup: Representative supported integral property: Replace301, Add2, Add3, Scale increments10% and20%. Permit duplicate equal Replace301 contributors. Compare all operation/slot orders within supported slot count, bundling multiple contributions in one relic where needed. Cases with distinct Replace302, negative forbidden result, overflow and mismatched units.
independent_oracle: (301+2+3)*(100+10+20)/100 = 397 after one truncation. Original base is ignored only by Replace; both identical Replace contributors remain visible. Sequential scale produces a different answer and must fail this oracle.
Distinct Replace always rejects atomically regardless of UUID/slot order. No silent clamp for forbidden negative or overflow. No-relic fixture retains original values.
minimum_new_evidence_groups.required_observation: Before/after property DTO and actual executor result for at least damage and one supported non-damage numeric property, contributor list and immutable previous roots on failure.
minimum_new_evidence_groups.limitations: 301 is a representative value, not official balance. Property-specific supported range/unit must be finalized; use checked fixed constants and wider independent hand arithmetic, never call product evaluator as oracle.

minimum_new_evidence_groups.title: Atomic recipe and effect-only footprint
minimum_new_evidence_groups.setup: Composite authored skill shares a carrier: Physical bite effect with finite footprint plus separate Self healing effect and unchanged cost/timing/source. Enlarge only bite; place enemy inside original area, enemy only in enlarged area, ally in enlarged area, caster and one control effect. Also apply single-support conversion then area-radius modifier.
independent_oracle: Both intended enemies receive authored Physical damage after enlargement. Self healing target/count/amount stay unchanged and nearby ally receives zero healing; unaffected effect and carrier retain their own behavior.

Removed area capability is absent/ineligible after single-support conversion. Radius modifier cannot alter support-selection distance or separate healing. Broken references and overlapping conflicting write sets produce no partial recipe.
minimum_new_evidence_groups.required_observation: Effective descriptor per effect plus actual target HP/heal deltas and preserved action/source/cost facts.
minimum_new_evidence_groups.limitations: Do not patch shared action target to emulate a per-effect footprint. Coordinate fixture must independently document inclusion/exclusion; compiler output is not its geometry oracle.

minimum_new_evidence_groups.title: Manual single-support target and identity lifetime
minimum_new_evidence_groups.setup: Normal public target selection for fetus and porcubbus. Three eligible allies plus enemy/nonemployee/out-of-range controls. Fetus caster attempt rejected; porcubbus caster allowed. Pin one target, move out and back using tactical commands, then withdraw/death/redeploy and source end. Check no auto-retarget or mid-activation replacement.
independent_oracle: Only the selected eligible battle identity gains membership. On range exit membership is empty; reentry restores same activation and balance, without extending expiry.

Invalidated selected identity ends its connection. Redeployment is a new identity and gets no inherited support, another ally is never substituted. Source end removes all links. Rejected inputs preserve roots and costs.
minimum_new_evidence_groups.required_observation: BeginSkillTargeting/ActivateSkill public validity and errors, sustained activation/caster/target/members/expires_at, actual buff/shield consumption.
minimum_new_evidence_groups.limitations: Area aura auto-join baseline remains reusable only for area form. New fixed-target validation/storage/query observability requires product design; no existing test proves this.

minimum_new_evidence_groups.title: One shared shield and single2S once after source calculation
minimum_new_evidence_groups.setup: Representative authored source expression base300 * source Attack200/100 gives S600. Area form starts one600 pool; separate single form starts1200. Selected recipient equipment has a modifier that would change value if erroneously applied again. Give personal shield50 and incoming800 under50% mitigation. Follow with incoming1800 under50% mitigation for single form. Area case use two recipients with mitigated400 then350. Exercise HP cost/heal/reentry/recast/expiry.
independent_oracle: Area: pool600→200 after400, then absorbs200 of350; second target HP loss150 and pool depleted. It is one pool, not600 per recipient.

Single: initial1200. First post-mitigation400 consumes personal50 then shared350; shared remaining850, HP loss0. Second post-mitigation900 consumes850 and HP loss50; no pool remains. Nonselected ally gets no shield. Recipient modifier never changes1200.

Source stat changes after creation do not recharge. Range exit/reentry preserves remaining850 and owner. Ordinary healing/Rest and authored HP cost do not charge pool. Source end/recast replaces owner; old expiry cannot end new activation.
minimum_new_evidence_groups.required_observation: Public pool capacity/remaining/members/activation, shield absorption source/ordering and actual target HP deltas, CostFact separately from DamageFact.
minimum_new_evidence_groups.limitations: Base300, S600, durations and costs are test values only. Do not infer official S formula, 4S corruption or duration. Rest must be checked only on supported lifecycle path; do not invent in-battle Rest.

minimum_new_evidence_groups.title: Fetus three final states and actual regular basic damage/speed
minimum_new_evidence_groups.setup: Raw Attack100, basic damage100, zero mitigation, baseline interval1000ms. Run area, normal single, corrupt single states independently. Retain separate active/proc control and observation off/on. Capture projectile before source expiry then let it land after expiry. Duplicate aura source exercises existing priority/nonstack semantics. Add an authored generated ExtraAttack and direct supported Triggered basic occurrence while aura is active; distinguish each occurrence from regular automatic schedule and equipment proc.
independent_oracle: Actual regular basic damage is120/140/180; final speed is115/120/130. Derived integer intervals are869/833/769ms where current interval calculation is floor(100000/speed). Confirm actual attack-start schedule, not only private aura accessor.

Raw Attack100 and active/proc control amounts remain unchanged; baseline active timing, resonance and work retain their own rules. Recipient remains attacker/killer; caster is buff provider. Values are final states, not20+40 or15+20.
Released attack retains captured bonus after expiry; subsequent basic returns to baseline. Channel blocks prohibited actions and stop resumes normally.

Regular-only enhancement: representative generated ExtraAttack/Triggered base100 remains100 while the independent regular attack is120/140/180. Preserve original extra-attack count/authority and its own timing; do not change the ordinary automatic schedule to simulate exclusion. Capture occurrence kind and causal source alongside final HP loss.
minimum_new_evidence_groups.required_observation: Actual HP delta and actor/provider facts, attack release/start timestamps, public stat/property values, source expiry and retained released payload. For ExtraAttack/Triggered controls, observe attack occurrence kind and cause; DamageSource::BasicAttack alone is insufficient to classify eligibility.
minimum_new_evidence_groups.limitations: 20/40/80 and15/20/30 are agreed values. Fixture duration and corruption penalty are representative only. Existing r11 baseline private snapshot test is not complete actual-damage evidence for all three states.

minimum_new_evidence_groups.title: Monk HpLost gate, one self-heal and unchanged Physical footprint semantics
minimum_new_evidence_groups.setup: Authored Physical bite100 and representative fixed Self heal37; caster startsHP500/max1000. Cases empty area, immune target, shield100, shield99, ordinary nonlethal target, killable HP1 target, several enemies with total positive HP loss. Separate maxHP990 case and source dead/unavailable before healing.
independent_oracle: Empty/immune/full absorption: settled bite HP loss0 and heal count0. Shield99 versus100: HP loss1 and exactly one heal37; shield100: zero heal. Kill and nonkill positive cases both heal37.
Any number of hit enemies still one caster heal; HP500→537. At990/max1000 applied heal10, no overflow shield. Other allies unchanged. No revival for dead caster.
Damage remains Physical and original source is retained. Gate reads settled bite HpLost>0, not ResolvedTargets, kill count or proportional lifesteal.
minimum_new_evidence_groups.required_observation: Per-target pre/post HP and shield deltas, action/producer settled HP-loss, caster heal mutation count/applied amount/target/source and effects-settled boundary.
minimum_new_evidence_groups.limitations: Current FlowMetric HpLost exists and condition checks producer phase2; new grant/recipe must bind the bite producer correctly. Existing proportional HP-loss expression test cannot prove fixed once-per-activation healing.

minimum_new_evidence_groups.title: Supported consumer binding, pause and released owners
minimum_new_evidence_groups.setup: Two normal employees with same SkillId and distinct relic/form configuration, observation off/on/saturated. Test immediate Manual, accepted while Pause then Resume, queued/released projectile, fixed area and Live source dependency. End/withdraw source after release, replace current plan, retain old observation owner until payload ends. Reuse existing positive source/reinput/corrosion regressions as impacted.
independent_oracle: Each employee consumes its own fixed oracle; shared original definition bytes unchanged. Pause ticks freeze battle time/HP/damage facts but accepted command may legitimately spend a resource; do not demand every fact counter remain unchanged.

Released Snapshot payload retains captured plan/source; unreleased/follow payload cancellation and Live missing-context atomic fault keep prior semantics. Old generation/provider cannot authorize new execution.
Provenance adds no executable authority; stale reinput/forged action and suppressed ego-corrosion additions stay rejected.
minimum_new_evidence_groups.required_observation: Public query plus real hit/amount/source fields, paused command causality and actual resume damage; Weak/ref ownership component checks complement public results.
minimum_new_evidence_groups.limitations: No fabricated employee active Auto API. Supported basic automatic attacks and Manual target modes remain distinct. Query witness retention is not entire action history.

minimum_new_evidence_groups.title: External new-ID generated effect and all three representative structures
minimum_new_evidence_groups.setup: Independent pack IDs after official pack: normal Event/reward grants relic A that adds Damage40 explosion and relic B selecting that generated effect with Add10 and Scale50%. Equip normally, cast through public application/trial. Execute porcubbus/fetus/monk authored representative forms through same public path with new IDs.
independent_oracle: Generated explosion40→75 from (40+10)*150/100, applied actual HP loss75 under known zero mitigation/no clamp. Original separate base effect stays its independent value; removing B returns40, removing A removes generated effect and makes B dormant.
Actual result and query agree for T06/T07/T08. Source includes correct A/B copies and original provider/form/generation; no duplicated original provider or minted action capability.
minimum_new_evidence_groups.required_observation: External content selection/load/registration, normal grant receipt, equip/target/cast command receipts, raw HP/result facts and read-only query before/after.
minimum_new_evidence_groups.limitations: Schema loading, admin-only grant or private world setup alone does not satisfy this group. Reuse normal Event/reward journey; fixture content does not claim full official encounter balance/UI completion.

minimum_new_evidence_groups.title: Copy, generation and restoration with fresh closure
minimum_new_evidence_groups.setup: Current/checkpoint/entry copies with Normal/Corrupt variants and paid/free transformation histories; restore fresh Core/Continue and supported retreat. Remove only seed, transfer relic, settle actual employee death recovery, clone and repeat battles. Attempt changed/missing content and forged graph restore.
independent_oracle: Same stored copy/variant/configuration reconstructs same closure and actual effect, not serialized stale graph. Missing/changed generation or forged graph leaves original nonempty state unchanged.

Seed removal cannot resurrect old generated effects. Retired payload owner lives only until permitted completion; repeated cycles release old plans/cache/pool/lease references. Clone mutation affects only its branch.
minimum_new_evidence_groups.required_observation: Public copy/history/save/generation and actual post-restore effect, plus direct Weak-owner/cumulative retained evidence for lifetime.
minimum_new_evidence_groups.limitations: Public root equality alone cannot establish allocator or hidden owner reclamation. Keep original restore and history tests intact.

minimum_new_evidence_groups.title: New cost owners, atomic late faults and channel HP-cost boundary
minimum_new_evidence_groups.setup: Measure closure candidate/plan/generated effect/source/cache/payload allocation and retained usage through current meter. Derive exact/one-short thresholds from published costs and independent counted fixture objects; hold populated current/checkpoint/entry and released owners. Inject supported late fault after provisional work. Channel fixture HP100 with health cost10; boundaryHP9/HP10/HP11 for nonlethal authored cost. Exercise pause, hard CC and explicit stop.
independent_oracle: Exact threshold succeeds; one-short fails with matching requested/accepted/retained accounting and unchanged state/RNG/ID/save. Retry after restoring limit produces same output as control. No clamped or partial graph.

For nonlethal cost10: HP9 andHP10 fail; HP11→1 succeeds once, shields untouched. Ordinary HP100→90. Pause does not repeatedly charge; hard CC/stop release only correct channel owner. Keep lethal allowed case separate.

Same seed/configuration and observations off/on/saturated give equal authority results. New retained rises are explainable by admitted objects; after source/lease/cache release old ownership does not accumulate.
minimum_new_evidence_groups.required_observation: Typed faults and actual admission counters, all public roots plus internal RNG/ID and ownership measures; real health cost fact and pool balance.
minimum_new_evidence_groups.limitations: Do not derive expected admission from a successful product measurement alone; bind independently counted objects and preserved cost contract. No cap/workload relaxation or common gameplay proc limit.
